title: The Hurt Syndicate: recruitment and tag-team dominance
summary: MVP’s arrival leads to conflict with Swerve and a championship run for Bobby Lashley and Shelton Benjamin.

chapters.title: Lashley defeats Swerve
chapters.result: Lashley beats Swerve in their singles match.
chapters.context: The confrontation follows MVP’s attempt to bring Swerve into his orbit.

chapters.title: The Syndicate win the tag titles
chapters.result: Lashley and Benjamin defeat Private Party.
chapters.context: Their partnership gains control of the tag championship.

chapters.title: Brodido end the reign
chapters.result: Brody King and Bandido win the three-way title match also featuring FTR.
chapters.context: The Syndicate’s first AEW tag-title reign ends.
